title: MsgChannelAvailability - Data API
description: Represents the availability of a Messaging channel for a specific country. This object is available in API version 67.0 and later.

CountryCode.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
CountryCode.description: The ISO country code for which the Messaging channel is available. There are 81 possible values for this field.

MessagingChannelId.description: The ID of the Messaging channel associated with this availability. This field is a relationship field.

Type.description: The type of availability. Valid value is: Country
